name: chat-app-scalable-monorepo
description: Professional, scalable full-stack real-time Chat Application

scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm run build && rm -rf ../dist && cp -r dist ../dist
